host.trustThisWorkspaceUsingVSCodeWorksp.en: Trust this workspace using VS Code Workspace Trust, then reopen AlwayGit.
host.trustThisWorkspaceUsingVSCodeWorksp.zh-CN: 请在 VS Code 中信任此工作区，然后重新打开 AlwayGit。

host.selectARepositoryOrAFolderContainin.en: Select a repository or a folder containing repositories
host.selectARepositoryOrAFolderContainin.zh-CN: 选择仓库或存放多个仓库的目录

host.theRepositoryScanHasExpiredScanTheF.en: The repository scan has expired. Scan the folder again.
host.theRepositoryScanHasExpiredScanTheF.zh-CN: 仓库扫描结果已失效，请重新扫描文件夹。

host.selectAtLeastOneAvailableRepository.en: Select at least one available repository.
host.selectAtLeastOneAvailableRepository.zh-CN: 请至少选择一个可添加的仓库。

host.theSelectedRepositoryGroupNoLongerE.en: The selected repository group no longer exists.
host.theSelectedRepositoryGroupNoLongerE.zh-CN: 所选仓库分组已不存在。

host.waitForTheRunningGitOperationBefore.en: Wait for the running Git operation before removing this repository.
host.waitForTheRunningGitOperationBefore.zh-CN: 请等待正在执行的 Git 操作完成后再移除仓库。

host.deleteRepositoryGroupItsRepositorie.en: Delete repository group "{{name}}"? Its repositories will remain at the repository root.
host.deleteRepositoryGroupItsRepositorie.zh-CN: 删除仓库分组“{{name}}”？其中的仓库会保留在仓库根层。

host.chooseARepositoryGroupOrTheReposito.en: Choose a repository group or the repository root
host.chooseARepositoryGroupOrTheReposito.zh-CN: 选择仓库分组或仓库根目录

host.useNoMoreThan80Characters.zh-CN: 分组名称不能超过 80 个字符。

host.aGroupWithThisNameAlreadyExists.en: A group with this name already exists.

host.gitExecutionRequiresATrustedWorkspa.en: Git execution requires a trusted workspace.
host.gitExecutionRequiresATrustedWorkspa.zh-CN: 请先信任工作区，再执行 Git 操作。

host.selectARegisteredNonBareWorktree.zh-CN: 请选择已注册的非 bare 工作树。

host.anOperationIsAlreadyRunningInThisRe.en: An operation is already running in this repository.
host.anOperationIsAlreadyRunningInThisRe.zh-CN: 此仓库已有正在执行的操作。

host.thePreviousGitOperationWasInterrupt.en: The previous Git operation was interrupted.
host.thePreviousGitOperationWasInterrupt.zh-CN: 上次 Git 操作中断，仓库保护仍保留。

host.confirmThatThePreviousAlwayGitWindo.en: Confirm that the previous AlwayGit window and all of its Git processes have ended, then inspect the repository status. Removing protection will not repeat the interrupted operation.
host.confirmThatThePreviousAlwayGitWindo.zh-CN: 请先确认上次 AlwayGit 窗口及其 Git 进程均已结束，并检查仓库状态。解除保护后需重新发起操作。

host.protectionRemovedRefreshTheReposito.en: Protection removed. Refresh the repository and retry the operation.
host.protectionRemovedRefreshTheReposito.zh-CN: 已解除保护，请刷新仓库并重新发起操作。

host.aGitOperationIsAlreadyRunningForThi.en: A Git operation is already running for this repository in another AlwayGit window.
host.aGitOperationIsAlreadyRunningForThi.zh-CN: 另一个 AlwayGit 窗口正在对该仓库执行 Git 操作。

host.sessionWritePending.en: VS Code state write is still pending after 10 seconds.
host.sessionWritePending.zh-CN: 等待 10 秒后，VS Code 状态写入仍未完成。

host.webviewMessageNotDelivered.en: VS Code did not deliver the message
host.webviewMessageNotDelivered.zh-CN: VS Code 未投递此消息

host.couldNotOpenWebLink.en: Could not open the web link. Copy it and open it in your browser.
host.couldNotOpenWebLink.zh-CN: 无法打开网页链接，请复制后在浏览器打开。
